projectDescription: A typed Python SDK that turns a Modal Sandbox into a remotely controllable Linux desktop, providing mouse, keyboard, screenshot, browser, and recording primitives for computer-use AI agents.
keyFeatures: Typed Python SDK for controlling a Linux desktop inside a Modal Sandbox
Sync and async interfaces (ComputerSandbox / AsyncComputerSandbox / AsyncDaemonClient)
Mouse, keyboard, clipboard, window management, and browser control namespaces
Screenshot capture, screen recordings, and artifact file management
Action batches with idempotency keys, per-action timeouts, and screenshot_after
Modal Function session handoff via ComputerSessionHandle.borrow_async()
OpenAI and Anthropic provider adapters with coordinate-space translation
Warm-pool management for low-latency sandbox reuse
Built-in action tracing, OpenTelemetry spans, and structured redacted logs
Configurable budgets for actions, screenshots, artifact bytes, and recording seconds
noVNC view-only and control modes for live desktop observation
Persistent artifact storage via Modal Volume v2
Attested-tunnel, Modal Connect, and direct-bearer ingress options
publicApiSurface: ComputerSandboxManager.create / attach / list / find / terminate / cleanup_expired
computer.mouse: click, move, drag, scroll, down, up, position
computer.keyboard: type, press, hotkey, hold, supported_keys
computer.recordings: start, stop, list, get, download, delete
computer.windows: list, active, activate, close, wait_for
computer.artifacts: list, read_bytes, write_bytes, download, upload, delete, manifest, sync
computer.processes: status, restart, logs, stderr, errors
ComputerConfig / ResourceConfig / BrowserConfig / NetworkConfig / StorageConfig / ActionConfig / BudgetConfig / RuntimeConfig / DesktopConfig / ImageConfig
